stage: Historical pre-download shortlist; see model-comparison/evaluation/RESULTS.md for the completed comparison and actual version-specific class lists.
scope: Public model-card review only; no model weights downloaded, no hosted inference requested, no user footage uploaded, no app changes.
recommendation: First assess a stair-direction model against existing development clips; prefer clear class meanings and a usable local deployment path over broad class counts.

candidates.name: Staircase Detection
candidates.image_count_note: Project and version counts differ; do not assume all version images are independent originals.
candidates.access_evidence: Page provides authenticated serverless API code. Downloadable compatible weights not verified.
candidates.decision: First candidate to assess for direction labels, not a proven stronger model. Small source collection, no local performance evidence.

candidates.name: accesibility street
candidates.access_evidence: Page provides authenticated serverless API code. Downloadable compatible weights not verified.
candidates.decision: Broader outdoor candidate; project taxonomy is mixed and model-version mapping must be verified. Pothole/crack boxes do not establish general open-hole detection, trip risk or metric depth.

candidates.name: Obstacle Detection
candidates.access_evidence: Page provides authenticated serverless API code. Downloadable compatible weights not verified.
candidates.decision: Secondary generic-hazard experiment; compound stairs-holes-curbs class cannot support distinct hole/curb/stair announcements.

candidates.name: Stairs_Detection
candidates.decision: Lower priority until numeric class meanings and model-version mapping are resolved. Publisher recall is not sufficient evidence of an improvement.

deployment_and_cost.current_publisher_statement: Free tier is available without a credit card. Supported model weights can be downloaded through Roboflow Inference or MCP on every plan; not all model types support this.
deployment_and_cost.candidate_specific_export_access: unverified; free-plan feature availability does not prove third-party model weights or compatible ONNX exports are available
deployment_and_cost.local_path: Verify model permission, architecture, input/output format and export availability; assess ONNX/WASM compatibility and actual iPhone cost before integration.
deployment_and_cost.hosted_path: Authenticated API; camera images leave device; internet, latency and usage limits apply. Requires deliberate product/privacy changes and keeping API credentials out of client bundles.

evaluation_notes: Publisher metrics are not PathSignal results or performance on the user's stairs.
Project-level licences and class lists do not establish model-weight terms or exact version mappings.
Project image counts may differ from augmented version counts.
General detection API snippets shown beside a custom model are not evidence that the custom checkpoint was used.
Use existing clips as development checks only; reserve independent scenes for final evaluation.
No candidate establishes distance measurement or independent walking.
